## Checklist

- [ ] Tests, lint and formatting pass (`npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`).
- [ ] Films and games are evoked in our own words, never named; books and hardware may be named as inspiration, with credit, but never in a theme or preset name (`src/test/trademarks.test.ts` checks the known titles).
- [ ] Claims about readability or comfort match what the tests measure (see the ergonomics page).
